title: 第13章  战斗训练第14章  不错的身手
slug: 御兽我契约的皆可返祖
content_zh:
夜离殇拍了拍胸脯，轻轻松了一口气。
“原来是从妖兽那里抢的，我还以为是从……”
夜离殇说道一半就没有再说下去，而是重新拿起一个小笼包吃了起来。
“以为什么？”
“我还能半夜拦路抢劫不成？”
龙疏寒轻声一笑，道：“先吃饭吧，等会去个安静点的地方，我教你一些新东西，顺便帮你训练一下云绒狐。”
龙疏寒说着，伸手在夜离殇的额头上轻轻地弹了一下。
“嗷嗷～”
夜离殇答应了一声，就专心地吃起早饭。
很快，早饭吃完。
夜离殇将茶几上的东西收拾干净后，就返回了自己的卧室，换了一身运动装出来。
“等一会你的雪球，等它把云灵绒心果吸收完，我们就出发。”
龙疏寒侧躺在沙发上，逐渐闭上自己的眼眸，进行闭目养神。
“好的，龙阿姨。”
夜离殇答应一声，就在沙发上坐下，静静等待起来。
……
两个小时后。
一声呜嘤的叫声从卧室中传来。
一道雪白的身影从卧室中冲出，一头扑进夜离殇的怀中，用小脑袋轻蹭着着夜离殇的胸口。
“体型稍微大了一点，体重也重了一些。”

夜离殇轻抚着怀中的云绒狐，嘴角带着淡淡的笑意。
“雪球也出来了，我们可以走了。”
龙疏寒伸展一下腰肢，从沙发上起身，往门口的方向走去。
夜离殇拍了拍云绒狐的小脑袋，起身跟上龙疏寒的步伐，云绒狐心领神会地跳到夜离殇的肩头。
离开房间。
夜离殇跟着龙疏寒来到繁华的街道上。
“龙阿姨，我们这是要去什么地方？”
夜离殇落后龙疏寒半步的距离，轻声询问着。
“野外。”
“你可要跟上我的步伐。”
龙疏寒将一只手背到身后，迈步往前方走去。
content_en:
Ye Lishang patted his chest and breathed a sigh of relief.
"It turns out it was stolen from a monster. I thought it was from..."
Ye Lishang stopped talking midway through, but picked up another xiaolongbao and started eating it.
"Why?"
"Can I still pull someone off in the middle of the night and rob someone?"
Long Shuhan smiled softly and said, "Let's eat first. Later, we will go to a quieter place. I will teach you some new things and help you train the Yunrong Fox."
Long Shuhan said, reaching out and flicking Ye Lishang's forehead lightly.
"Ouch~"
Ye Lishang agreed and concentrated on eating breakfast.
Soon, breakfast was finished.
After Ye Lishang cleaned up the things on the coffee table, he returned to his bedroom and changed into sportswear.
"Wait for your snowball, wait until it has absorbed the Yunling Velvet Heart Fruit, and then we'll set off."
Long Shuhan lay on his side on the sofa, gradually closed his eyes and rested his mind.
"Okay, Aunt Long."
Ye Lishang agreed, sat down on the sofa, and waited quietly.
…
Two hours later.
A whining sound came from the bedroom.
A snow-white figure rushed out of the bedroom, threw himself into Ye Lizhang's arms, and rubbed his little head against Ye Lizhang's chest.
"A little bit bigger and a little heavier."
Ye Li Shang gently caressed the Yunrong Fox in his arms, with a faint smile on his lips.
"Snowball is out too, we can go."
Long Shuhan stretched his waist, got up from the sofa, and walked towards the door.
Yeli Shang patted Yunrong Hu's little head, stood up and followed Long Shuhan's pace, and Yunrong Hu jumped onto Yeli Shang's shoulder knowingly.
Leave the room.
Ye Lishang followed Long Shuhan to the bustling street.
"Aunt Long, where are we going?"
Yeli Shang was half a step behind Long Shuhan and asked softly.
"The wild."
"You have to keep up with me."
Long Shuhan put one hand behind his back and walked forward.
